snippet.title: Evercade - TAITO Arcade 3 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming February 2026. Pre-order today!

TAITO Arcade 3 continues Evercade’s mission to preserve and celebrate arcade history, offering another authentic collection of TAITO favourites for players and collectors alike. All with a physical cartridge and full colour manual, compatible with all Evercade and HyperMegaTech! cartridge systems.

Launching in February 2026, this new cartridge features nine classic arcade titles, showcasing the variety and creativity of TAITO’s signature era:

Included Games:

CADASH
CAMELTRY
CRAZY BALLOON
THE FAIRYLAND STORY
FOOTBALL CHAMP
LUNAR RESCUE
PUZZLE BOBBLE
QIX
ZOO KEEPER

Find out more: https://evercade.co.uk/cartridges/taito-arcade-3/
Discover Evercade: https://evercade.co.uk
